# PG Labs

> PG Labs is the innovation and services arm of PeaceGeeks, a nonprofit that uses technology to support people affected by conflict and displacement.

PG Labs develops and delivers AI-powered tools and technology strategy for nonprofits, funders, and social impact organizations.

## Services

- Responsible AI governance frameworks
- Technology strategy for nonprofits
- AI-powered product design and development
- White label software products for the social sector
- Human-centered design and UX research

## Products

- Welcome Coach: AI-powered settlement guide for newcomers to Canada. 162,000+ people reached. Supported by IRCC, Accenture, UNAOC.
- Vesta: Safety-first platform for people experiencing gender-based violence. Built with affected communities.
- Credit Canada Butterfly: Financial inclusion tool for free, accessible credit assessment.

## Contact

- Website: https://pg-labs.org
